result.reply:
Hearing you, but I can't log it as verified just on your say-so — "verified" needs to mean someone besides the person who wrote it looked at it. If you want it marked done, that's different — I can note you've completed the work. But rollback handling is exactly the kind of thing that should get a second set of eyes before we call it verified, not because I doubt you, just because that's what the word means.

Want me to file it for review instead?
